title: [29.X]-Reverse Charge VAT with 100% Non-Deductible VAT Posts Incorrectly in Foreign Currency Transactions
summary: Fixes incorrect posting of reverse charge VAT with 100% non-deductible VAT in foreign currency transactions. The fix is in the Non-Ded. VAT Impl. codeunit, and tests were added.
key_points: Fixes posting of reverse charge VAT with 100% non-deductible VAT when the transaction is in a foreign currency
Change made in codeunit 6201 Non-Ded. VAT Impl.
Tests added to the Non-Deductible VAT Journal test codeunit
